# Test fixtures

**Everything here is synthetic.** All names (`R1_Lead`, `R2_Architect`, … `R9_Manager`), employee IDs (1001–1099), customers (`TestCo`), projects, PO numbers, rates and amounts are invented. This folder is public; never add real data. `tests/unit/fixtures.test.js` checks for e-mail addresses and long numbers.

Documented synthetic IDs: PO numbers `100100100`, `100100101`, `200200200`, `300300300`, `400400400`, `400400401`; project IDs `111111`–`444444`; opportunity numbers in the style `O-0000001`.

| File | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `legacy-config-basic.json` | A legacy working config in normalised shape, built from the `test_*` files: 4 POs (`PO_Validity` as `mm-yy`), 14 resource rules (UK dates normalised by the legacy parser), FX rates, OT rules, expenses, invoices, and `raw_actuals` = the first 200 timesheet rows |
| `legacy-config-multicurrency.json` | One GBP PO with expenses in GBP, USD and INR; FX rates change on 2026-01-01 (C-03, effective-dated FX) |
| `legacy-config-2027.json` | POs and resources spanning 2026–2027, a `06-27` validity, a rollover PO and a pending PO (year filter, multi-year forecast) |
| `timesheet-quoted.csv` | UTF-8 BOM, CRLF line endings, names and customers containing commas inside quotes, an escaped `""` quote (C-04) |
| `timesheet-duplicates.csv` | The same employee, date and project on two rows with different activities (not a duplicate), plus one exact duplicate row (D-05, D-06) |
| `timesheet-ambiguous-dates.csv` | `03/04/2026` and `04/03/2026` (ambiguous), `13/04/2026` (day first), `04/13/2026` (month first), a 2-digit year and an ISO date (C-05) |
| `resources-uk-dates.csv` | Resource rules with `D/M/YYYY` dates, 1–2 digit days and months, a 2-digit year and an ambiguous `02/03/2026` (DEC-018-R1) |
| `xlsx/timesheet-basic.xlsx` | The first 20 timesheet rows of the basic config as an Excel workbook. Generated by `node tests/support/make-xlsx-fixtures.js` with the vendored SheetJS 0.18.5 |
| `references.csv` | Project crosswalk for `references-crosswalk-v1` (IMP-005): `O-0000001` (PO team `111111_ProjectAlpha_AWS`, project `111111`) and `O-0000002` (Beta and Gamma teams, projects `222222` and `333333`), matching `legacy-config-basic.json`. The first ref is in lower case on purpose (normalised to `O-0000001`); one list has a space after `;` |

The three JSON configs were generated once from the `test_*` files by a script that applied the legacy app's own normalisation (resource dates through the legacy `parseDate(…, 'uk')`). Their `_fixture` field states that they are synthetic; the legacy app ignores unknown fields.
